column1: # Evaluator probes on repeating fields (MBS example AppleTouchBar, as
# x01-repetitions): table occurrence ATB (03d00001), record ID 2. Data survey
# first, then operands holding field references and repetition indexes.
ExecuteSQL ( "SELECT TableName, FieldName, FieldType, FieldClass, FieldReps FROM FileMaker_Fields WHERE TableName = 'ATB'" ; "|" ; "¶" )
Let ( f = ATB::flex_Label[2] ; f & "|" & Count ( f ) )
Let ( [ f = ATB::flex_Label ; g = f ] ; Count ( g ) )
Let ( f = If ( 1 ; ATB::flex_Label ; 0 ) ; Count ( f ) )
While ( [ f = ATB::flex_Label ; i = 0 ] ; i < 1 ; [ i = i + 1 ] ; Count ( f ) )
Let ( f = ATB::_Table ; f & "|" & Extend ( f ) )
